product.title: New York in One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour
product.description: Make the most of your time in New York City by taking a tour that includes transportation. Take a bus ride past the 9/11 Memorial, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, and more. Then hop aboard the Staten Island Ferry to see the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island.
highlights: A perfect introduction for first-time visitors to New York City
Hear informative commentary on the history and people that shaped NYC
Tickets for a ride on the Staten Island Ferry are included
See major highlights on a bus tour, without having to sort out transportation
exclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off not included

start.description: 770 7th Ave, New York, NY 10019, USA. Departure/End Point: 7th Avenue, between 50th & 51st Streets (middle of the block) in Manhattan. Please arrive 20 - 25 minutes before tour departure time for a timely check in.

product.itinerarySummary: Start your comprehensive New York City tour in Midtown Manhattan at a convenient check-in location. Board a climate-controlled bus to begin a journey packed with iconic sights. Drive through Times Square, stop at Central Park and Rockefeller Center, continue along Fifth Avenue, break at Gansevoort Liberty Market, visit the 9/11 Memorial, and conclude with a Staten Island Ferry ride with views of the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island.
additionalInfo: Not recommended for travelers with back problems
No heart problems or other serious medical conditions
Travelers should have a moderate physical fitness level

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance of the experience for a full refund.

faq.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faq.answer: The tour departs from 770 7th Ave in Manhattan and ends back at the meeting point.
